name: minoren-in-de-buurt
description: Nederlandse spraakagent die hbo-studenten helpt passende minoren te vinden (data: Kies op Maat)

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.dev:testdata: npm run import:testdata && MINORS_FILE=test/fixtures/minors.test.json npm run dev
